notes.title: Autumn Update, 20% Off and Spelkollektivet Anniversary Sale!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're back with an autumn update for Korter 1996! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/6e0dd43bc65989cbe097990982d13d2586c58581.png"] 

This update is packed with bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and a few extra story-beats, interactions and items. You can safely use your existing save game and see the newly added items, and if you already completed the game, I would recommend experiencing the ending again!




Content changes:

Improved UI for the start of the game

Improved credits sequence with “where are they now” pictures

Wallpaper and colour enhancements in the Mechanic’s apartment

More items for the Seamstress

Recoloured the cat




Bug fixes:

Continued fixes to decrease the chance of the pink screen bug on Mac

Fixed a couple of sprite sorting and placement issues

Fixed an incorrect post-it label on the liquid puzzle

Fixed the "Plushie Picnic" achievement triggering

Fixed a layering issue on the PC

Made sure you can pet the cat, even after you completed all the content in that apartment!




The path ahead for Korter 1996 definitely features a few more of these updates. We launched the game with the full story we wanted to tell and a generally bug free path from start to end, so we're really proud of that! But we’re not quite done yet. For future updates we want to make every apartment feel really lived in, and make sure every character's story is properly realised and has a satisfying finale. Next up, we’ll do a big items update, making the decorating part more interesting and versatile.




In other exciting news…
Starting now: Spelkollektivet 8th Anniversary Sale!
That means;

 - Korter 1996 is 20% off!

 - Korter 1996 is 50% off if you purchase the Spelkollektivet Mega Bundle!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/656c619e45a1780be40a9dc28c96d8d05f7e2a6a.png"]

It means a lot to be included since Spel has been the place that supported us throughout the development of Korter.




Thanks for supporting us and playing our game :)

Flan, Mari-Anna, Brian & Mitsuko <3

notes.title: July Update
notes.notes:
Korter 1996 July Update


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/e9a30b6de2eaeded0b48cd290fec9f81d2185df9.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/d7acd348408cffa11e84118c63ec67957c629e79.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/1ae458645a4022f7ce248dcbc64e6f46cf6a998a.jpg"]



Oooh, so it’s been almost three weeks after our release and honestly, it feels more like a month. We’ve been doing small patches to deal with the more annoying bugs based on your feedback and on Tuesday we published a bigger update that concludes this month’s patch-work.



Bug fixes

The morning recording sequence had trouble starting automatically after loading the game so we decided for it to be interaction-based. So, you have to make the extra click to start the recording but it now always works.

An issue on some Mac models made all of the sprites turn hot pink until you toggled fullscreen, so we got a slightly dirty fix to make it refresh the sprites on startup.

Steam Achievements went live last week but now we’ve made sure you can actually achieve all of them.

Made sure music always switches when going through the Main Menu.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/1a3ebdf43bbc41f4f97f709ee0118ba939a3c34d.png"]

Other

Added a new cursor type for navigating the stairs.

Fixed some visuals where objects weren’t perfectly aligned with outlines.

Added more variation in item placement SFX.

Made sure all the drawers sound like drawers when opened.

Added some other visual and audio adjustments, improving on continuity.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/f0c4f5478d307b495eaf7d2cc0a85b3b17cb9d16.gif"]


Update timeline


We’ll be working on more updates in the coming seasons, adding in some of the stuff we wanted to but didn’t have time for earlier. This is a “not set in stone” plan for what you can expect from us in the next months.



August - Summer update - Items and stuff

October - Autumn update - More backrooms and lore

+ Regular patches to deal with bugs



Thank you so much for playing ‭❤❤❤

Mari-Anna, Flan & Brian



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/b32c5af56336fad4e9e05c7cfaa4f193c7ae8cfb.png"]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 3
notes.notes:
We fixed even more things!


 The loading order for Progress is now 100% accurate
 Unlocking achievements show the Steam toast immediately, instead of after the game
 When loading, the notebook now opens to the correct page
 When quitting to main menu during a sleep scene, the night sounds stop
 Some plates were given different names so they load correctly
 Attempt to fix a visual glitch the first time you look at each scene after a load
 The PC now correctly adds UI elements when loading
 Wallet slots now show what is in them immediately when loading
 Daily recap trigger now happens even after a load
 Fix the Day 5 softlock that stopped you sleeping


That's all for now, hopefully this build will run real smooth :)

notes.title: Achievements (and Bugfixes)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I hope you have been enjoying this first week of playing with Korter 1996! We've been so thrilled to see your screenshots, reviews and lovely comments on our game. We wanted to reward some of your more... interesting decorating choices, and give you a little something to hunt for, so we've added achievements!

https://i.imgur.com/vpKvjXl.png

Full patch notes:

 Added 30 achievements to the game, including 7 hidden achievements. Can you find them all?
 Fixed several save/load issues
 All items in the game can now be loaded (the load system had an old list of items, and would miss a few things towards the end of the game)
 When loading, progression actually unlocks in the right order this time. (I thought I fixed this in the hotfix, but I guess it slipped through)
 Added sound effects to lots of items that either had no pickup/place sound or had the default sound


Also, our launch discount ends in UNDER 24 HOURS!!! Now's the time to buy it for everyone in your apartment block!

Flan <3

notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/x48fO4h.png

Hi there!

 We're so happy people are enjoying our game and leaving lovely feedback. We've got a great hotfix for you this morning, basically fixing the entire save/load system, so you can actually take your time and decorate your Korter over multiple sessions <3


 Major fix to loading save games. (It now unlocks your progress in the correct order, so that the correct objects are activated and triggered in the correct order)
 Save which items you've taken out of the catalogue, no more infinite items sorry
 Fix the Back button in menu being blocked when in 16:10 ratio (it was the version number overlapping)
 Music transitions back to the regular in-game track if you press "Continue" after credits

notes.title: Demo Patch 2
notes.notes:
Our final demo patch before the release is now live! Just in time for Next Fest. We’ve done a big UI overhaul to make it feel more like it’s part of the world that you are exploring. You can read more about the details below.

UI updates

 You can now sit down and enjoy your tea while you read your notebook
 Turn your notebook pages by hand!
 You will be able to collect puzzle pieces in your wallet
 Listen back to your audio notes with a portable cassette player
 Avoid surprise scene transitions with handy confirmation dialogues
 Clickable areas give you a feeling in your fingers (and a rainbow on your cursor)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101105/19f1373bf4ac833665aaeb2ee8ce543b00042a2f.gif

Item placements

 Resizing item sprites and adjusting deadzones for easier pickup
 Adjusting shelf sizes for more snug placements
 Cleaned up any “locked” doors that were unavailable in the demo


Bug Fixes

 Optimizing to improve performance of different devices
 Cap framerate and prevent a couple of issues at super high framerates
 Fix gravity not working on top of the toy bear’s head
 Slight colour palette updates


Next up we'll be adding more content and work towards the full release of the game!

Mari-Anna & Flan
Approved by Mitsuko

notes.title: Demo Patch 1
notes.notes:
After the demo launch, taking some time off and looking at the project with fresh eyes we've now made some fixes that we thought were important for making the demo more enjoyable. If you haven't got to trying it out yet, now's a good time.

Here's a summary of what we've improved:

Content Changes

 Made the placements in the starting apartment feel more snug
 Added an audio-visual treat to solving the final puzzle of the demo
 Some characters now have hidden portraits until you “meet” them
 Improved the puzzle-solving flow in apartment 5


Bug Fixes

 Fix some bugs where you could click through solid sprites
 Fix some outlines not showing correctly when hovering over objects
 Fix some hints that weren’t showing up
 Prevent UI elements going over the edge of the Address Book
 Increased the interaction area for some awkward sprites
 Changed the magazine when you already found it
 Fix transparent items being invisible when previewed
 Fix a visual error in the portal shader at large resolutions


Look out for more updates coming up in the next months!

Oink! 🐷
Mari-Anna & Flan
